load_errors.2: not a 32-bit ELF file (64-bit programs need a 64-bit ISA card and format/elf64, which do not exist yet)
load_errors.3: big-endian: this machine's bus is little-endian
load_errors.4: the ELF machine is not the one this machine card runs
load_errors.5: not an executable (ELF type is neither EXEC nor DYN)
load_errors.6: the program asks for a dynamic loader (PT_INTERP): only static executables run yet
load_errors.7: a loadable segment lies outside the process's memory
load_errors.8: a segment's file bytes lie outside the file

name: elf32
statement: The 32-bit ELF executable, read by card logic: the header and program-header fields as offsets and sizes, the constants loading needs, which machine card runs a given e_machine, and the loader's error codes. probe.card reads a file's identity (which machine runs it); load.card, a component of that machine, copies every PT_LOAD segment's file bytes to its virtual address, zeroes the rest of its memory size and sets the entry point. The host only hands over the file's bytes.
